network_enforcement: The checker invokes check_proof.sh inside Bubblewrap with the host mounted read-only, a disposable /tmp, and --unshare-net. The replay uses only the existing pinned local Lean dependency closure and cannot fetch or mutate it. It remains warm nonrelease evidence rather than a cold empty-cache build.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release decision summary

coverage_semantics: covered_obligation_ids are the nodes supported by the checker-invoked exact-root Lean observation and checked package/composition boundaries. reconciled_inventory_ids are structurally inspected only to derive a fail-closed terminal decision and receive no proof-closure credit.
scope_boundary: Fail-closed current-snapshot reconciliation of provisional proof and validation evidence. The checker verifies hashes, receipt fields, graph state, source hygiene, and invokes check_proof.sh to re-elaborate the exact package and root. That warm replay is not cold, hermetic, or independent. The recipe cannot master-accept the validation dependency, reconcile the frozen proof route, establish accepted M0-L/E0, supply H0/R0 or AUDIT-Z, close foundation/provenance/TCB, provide a clean cold offline build, independent attestations or verifier, protected CI, or assemble a deterministic release bundle.
